# MUNIComb

> The network is the product.

MUNIComb — Mesh Unity Network Incentive — is a new kind of computing network,
currently taking shape. Launching Fall 2026.

## The problem

The world's spare compute is staggering, and most of it sits at zero
utilization: old graphics cards, retired office machines, phones replaced on a
two-year cycle. Hardware that still works, doing nothing. MUNIComb's opening
argument is that this "junk" can punch above its weight — put to work, it
becomes productive infrastructure.

## What it is

A decentralized mesh that turns idle hardware into productive AI compute,
starting with AI video generation pipelines (script, voice, edit, render).
Contributors get paid for real work completed — nothing for nothing. The mesh
grows. Everyone can play.

## Who it's for

- **Hardware owners**: people with idle machines — old GPUs, spare computers,
  phones — who want that hardware earning instead of gathering dust.
- **Customers**: people and teams who need AI media work done and want finished
  output, not server time.

## Principles

- Tend the mesh. Don't own it.
- Nothing is useless. If it computes, it counts.
- Nurture, don't control: the network grows because participants choose it.
- Idle is an opportunity: every idle cycle is inventory waiting for demand.
- Everyone can play: the worker footprint is deliberately tiny, built to run on
  anything from aging GPUs down to phones.
- Prove it, then scale it: every claim is demonstrated on real hardware first.

## What MUNIComb is not

- Not a token presale. There is no ICO, no presale, no public token sale.
- Not cloud mining.
- Not a hosting company. The network never hosts content; it produces work
  for customers who own what they make.

## Glossary

- **MUNIComb**: Mesh Unity Network Incentive — the project and the network.
- **The mesh**: the network of contributor machines doing the work.
- **Node operators**: the people who run machines on the mesh.

## Status

In private development. Public launch Fall 2026. Watch this domain.
